component.name: Big Audio Converter
component.summary: Convert audio and export selected segments

description.p: Convert local audio to MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC, WAV or Ogg Vorbis, or extract an audio track from a video. Preview effects and mark segments to keep or remove on the waveform, or enter their times with the keyboard.

Remove pauses marks the speech between the pauses, so the export leaves them out. Keeping the original format avoids re-encoding, with cut precision limited by the codec and container. Optional speech noise reduction uses DeepFilterNet3 or native DPDFNet-2. Tags and cover art are preserved where the destination supports them.

screenshot.caption: Queue, conversion settings and the waveform with marked segments

description.p: Remove pauses from speech, keep segments per file across the queue, and remember the equalizer.
